summary_md: **Senro ([@Senro_AI](https://x.com/Senro_AI/status/2115214304874226139))** reports that PlayCanvas's **SuperSplat 3.7** adds 24 **WebMCP** tools, so AI agents can inspect, edit and export 3D (Gaussian-splat) scenes directly in the browser editor, with agent edits sharing the editor's normal undo history. Links to the v3.7.0 release notes.
relevance: Browser-native MCP tooling for 3D scene editing — agents operating a real 3D editor rather than generating files blind.
